summary: Completed comprehensive testing of HOME OS - THE FINAL CIRCUIT. All major features working correctly: (1) Global 24px spacing with --os-gap CSS variable, (2) Settings redesigned with 3 tabs [AESTHETICS|CONNECTIONS|SYSTEM MEMORY], custom color picker, connection inputs, export/import, (3) THE SANCTUM with Library (EB Garamond 24px, intervention mode #1a1814 bg + #d4af37 accent) and Resilience checklist with daily auto-reset, (4) THE ORACLE with SVG area chart and 3 sliders. All regression tests passed for ARENA, NODE, navigation, VIRGIL, and Wellbeing check-in.
